# Load packages
```{r}
# Install packages not yet installed
packages <- c("hablar", "readxl", "tidyverse")
installed_packages <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == FALSE)) {
  utils::install.packages(pkgs = packages[!installed_packages])
}
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)) # load all packages in list
# install packages not on CRAN
if (!require("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")
rm(installed_packages, packages) # remove objects from environment
```
# Fixing spreadsheet

### Import
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
path <- "ICP-MS/ICP-MS_rawdata.xlsx"
testing1 <- path %>% 
  excel_sheets() %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map(read_xlsx, path = path)
rm(path)
# saveRDS(testing1, "RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_raw.RDS")
```

### remove blank rows, weird formatting in sheets
```{r}
testing1 <- ICP_MS
for (i in 4:length(ICP_MS)){
testing2 <- testing1[[i]]
testing2 <- testing2[,-1]
names <- as.vector(unlist(testing2[1,]))
colnames(testing2) <- names
testing2 <- testing2[-1,]
testing1[[i]] <- retype(testing2,)
}
ICP_MS <- testing1
rm(testing1,testing2,i,names)
# saveRDS(ICP_MS, "RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_clean.RDS")
```
### Make single DF (unlist)
```{r}
ICP_MS <- readRDS("RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_clean.RDS")
# 30 - 184 are otoliths
df <- ICP_MS[c(30:184)]
names(df)
# no specimen 14
# specimen 24 missing a third scan
for(i in 1:155){
  spec <- names(df[i])
  df[[i]]$specimen <- as.factor(str_sub(spec, start= 0,end = 5))
  df[[i]]$transect <- as.factor(as.numeric(str_sub(spec, start= -1)) + 1)
  rm(spec,i)
}
df <- do.call("rbind", df)
df <- rename(df, "time" = `Elapsed Time`)
# saveRDS(df, "RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_df.RDS")
rm(ICP_MS, df)
```

# Data filtering/cutoffs

### Function to detect otolith boundaries using Cu65
```{r}
# ===================================================================
# Full ICP-MS Data Cleaning Workflow
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD PACKAGES
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install packages not yet installed
packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "zoo", "purrr")
installed_packages <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == FALSE)) {
  install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)) # Load all packages


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DATA IMPORT AND WRANGLING
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# This section reads your raw multi-sheet Excel file and creates a
# single tidy dataframe.
#
# NOTE: If you already have "RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_df.RDS", you can
# skip this entire section and go to Section 3.

# --- Fix Spreadsheet ---
path <- "ICP-MS/ICP-MS_rawdata.xlsx"
all_sheets <- path %>%
  excel_sheets() %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(read_xlsx, path = path)

specimen.vars <- c(
  "oto01-0", "oto01-1", "oto01-2", "oto01-3", "oto10-0", "oto10-1", "oto10-2",
  "oto10-3", "oto11-0", "oto11-1", "oto11-2", "oto11-3", "oto12-0", "oto12-1",
  "oto12-2", "oto12-3", "oto13-0", "oto13-1", "oto13-2", "oto13-3", "oto15-0",
  "oto15-1", "oto15-2", "oto15-3", "oto16-0", "oto16-1", "oto16-2", "oto16-3",
  "oto17-0", "oto17-1", "oto17-2", "oto17-3", "oto18-0", "oto18-1", "oto18-2",
  "oto18-3", "oto19-0", "oto19-1", "oto19-2", "oto19-3", "oto02-0", "oto02-1",
  "oto02-2", "oto02-3", "oto20-0", "oto20-1", "oto20-2", "oto20-3", "oto21-0",
  "oto21-1", "oto21-2", "oto21-3", "oto22-0", "oto22-1", "oto22-2", "oto22-3",
  "oto23-0", "oto23-1", "oto23-2", "oto23-3", "oto24-0", "oto24-1", "oto24-2",
  "oto25-0", "oto25-1", "oto25-2", "oto25-3", "oto26-0", "oto26-1", "oto26-2",
  "oto26-3", "oto27-0", "oto27-1", "oto27-2", "oto27-3", "oto28-0", "oto28-1",
  "oto28-2", "oto28-3", "oto29-0", "oto29-1", "oto29-2", "oto29-3", "oto03-0",
  "oto03-1", "oto03-2", "oto03-3", "oto30-0", "oto30-1", "oto30-2", "oto30-3",
  "oto31-0", "oto31-1", "oto31-2", "oto31-3", "oto32-0", "oto32-1", "oto32-2",
  "oto32-3", "oto33-0", "oto33-1", "oto33-2", "oto33-3", "oto34-0", "oto34-1",
  "oto34-2", "oto34-3", "oto35-0", "oto35-1", "oto35-2", "oto35-3", "oto36-0",
  "oto36-1", "oto36-2", "oto36-3", "oto37-0", "oto37-1", "oto37-2", "oto37-3",
  "oto38-0", "oto38-1", "oto38-2", "oto38-3", "oto39-0", "oto39-1", "oto39-2",
  "oto39-3", "oto40-0", "oto40-1", "oto40-2", "oto40-3", "oto04-0", "oto04-1",
  "oto04-2", "oto04-3", "oto05-0", "oto05-1", "oto05-2", "oto05-3", "oto06-0",
  "oto06-1", "oto06-2", "oto06-3", "oto07-0", "oto07-1", "oto07-2", "oto07-3",
  "oto08-0", "oto08-1", "oto08-2", "oto08-3", "oto09-0", "oto09-1", "oto09-2",
  "oto09-3"
)
specimens <- setNames(all_sheets[30:184], specimen.vars)
specimens <- specimens[order(names(specimens))]
ICP_MS_list <- c(all_sheets[1:29], specimens)

# --- Clean up sheets ---
for (i in 4:length(ICP_MS_list)) {
  testing2 <- ICP_MS_list[[i]]
  testing2 <- testing2[, -1]
  names <- as.vector(unlist(testing2[1, ]))
  colnames(testing2) <- names
  testing2 <- testing2[-1, ]
  suppressWarnings({
    testing2 <- type.convert(testing2, as.is = TRUE)
  })
  ICP_MS_list[[i]] <- testing2
}

# --- Make single DF (unlist) ---
df_list <- ICP_MS_list[c(30:184)]
for (i in 1:length(df_list)) {
  spec <- names(df_list[i])
  df_list[[i]]$specimen <- as.factor(str_sub(spec, start = 0, end = 5))
  df_list[[i]]$transect <- as.factor(as.numeric(str_sub(spec, start = -1)) + 1)
}

df <- do.call("rbind", df_list)
df <- rename(df, "time" = `Elapsed Time`)
# Optional: save the processed dataframe so you can skip the above steps next time
# dir.create("RDS_dataframes", showWarnings = FALSE)
# saveRDS(df, "RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_df_newlyfixed.RDS")


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. DEFINE CLEANING PARAMETERS
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

# List of transects to REMOVE entirely
bad_transects <- tribble(
  ~specimen, ~transect,
  "oto10", 2,
  "oto10", 3,
  "oto18", 1,
  "oto18", 2,
  "oto18", 3,
  "oto18", 4,
  "oto21", 1,
  "oto22", 1,
  "oto26", 2,
  "oto26", 3,
  "oto26", 4,
  "oto35", 2
) %>%
  mutate(transect = as.factor(transect))

# List of transects to MANUALLY trim
manual_cutoffs <- tribble(
  ~specimen, ~transect, ~start_time, ~end_time,
  "oto39",  "1",         8.45,        151.4,
  "oto39",  "2",         11.36,       154,
  "oto39",  "3",         10.83,       153.78,
  "oto39",  "4",         7.92,        149.03
) %>%
  mutate(transect = as.factor(transect))


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. DEFINE HELPER FUNCTIONS
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

#' (Function 1) Trim ICP-MS data with smoothing and a buffer.
trim_otolith_transect_v3 <- function(data,
                                     element_col = "Ca43",
                                     threshold_quantile = 0.25,
                                     smooth_window = 10,
                                     buffer_points = 3) {
  data %>%
    group_by(specimen, transect) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(trimmed_data = map(data, function(transect_df) {
      if (nrow(transect_df) < smooth_window || !element_col %in% names(transect_df)) return(NULL)
      
      smoothed_signal <- zoo::rollmean(transect_df[[element_col]], k = smooth_window, fill = "extend")
      threshold_value <- quantile(transect_df[[element_col]], threshold_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
      above_threshold_indices <- which(smoothed_signal > threshold_value)
      
      if (length(above_threshold_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
      
      start_pos <- min(above_threshold_indices)
      end_pos <- max(above_threshold_indices)
      start_pos <- max(1, start_pos - buffer_points)
      end_pos <- min(nrow(transect_df), end_pos + buffer_points)
      
      transect_df %>% slice(start_pos:end_pos)
    })) %>%
    select(specimen, transect, trimmed_data) %>%
    unnest(cols = c(trimmed_data)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

#' (Function 2) Create a diagnostic plot for a single specimen
plot_trim_check <- function(original_df, trimmed_df, specimen_id) {
  specimen_original <- filter(original_df, specimen == specimen_id)
  specimen_trimmed <- filter(trimmed_df, specimen == specimen_id)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = specimen_original, aes(x = time, y = Ca43, color = transect), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(data = specimen_trimmed, aes(x = time, y = Ca43, color = transect)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Specimen:", specimen_id, "(Final Trim)"),
      subtitle = "Dashed = Original, Solid = Final Trimmed Data",
      x = "Time (s)", y = "Ca43 Signal (cps)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    facet_wrap(~transect)
  
  return(p)
}


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. DATA CLEANING WORKFLOW
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# If you skipped Section 2, load the dataframe from your saved file:
# df <- readRDS("RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_df.RDS")

# Step 5.1: Remove bad transects
df_filtered <- anti_join(df, bad_transects, by = c("specimen", "transect"))

# Step 5.2: Separate the data into "auto" and "manual" groups
manual_specimen_ids <- unique(manual_cutoffs$specimen)
df_for_auto_trim <- filter(df_filtered, !(specimen %in% manual_specimen_ids))
df_for_manual_trim <- filter(df_filtered, specimen %in% manual_specimen_ids)

# Step 5.3: Run automatic trimming on the "auto" group
auto_trimmed_df <- trim_otolith_transect_v3(df_for_auto_trim)

# Step 5.4: Run manual trimming on the "manual" group
manual_trimmed_df <- df_for_manual_trim %>%
  left_join(manual_cutoffs, by = c("specimen", "transect")) %>%
  filter(time >= start_time & time <= end_time) %>%
  select(-start_time, -end_time)

# Step 5.5: Combine the two datasets into the final clean version
final_clean_df <- bind_rows(auto_trimmed_df, manual_trimmed_df) %>%
  arrange(specimen, transect, time) # Arrange for good measure

cat("Workflow complete! Your final, clean data is in 'final_clean_df'. ✨\n")

# saveRDS(final_clean_df, "RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_final_clean_maybe.RDS")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. FINAL VERIFICATION PLOT
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# This will create a multi-page PDF showing the final results for all specimens.

# Get the list of all specimens included in the final dataset
all_specimens_final <- unique(final_clean_df$specimen)

# Create the PDF
pdf("diagnostic_plots_FINAL.pdf", width = 11, height = 8.5)

walk(all_specimens_final, ~{
  # The original data for comparison is df_filtered
  p <- plot_trim_check(original_df = df_filtered, 
                       trimmed_df = final_clean_df, 
                       specimen_id = .x)
  print(p)
})

dev.off()

cat("Final verification PDF saved as 'diagnostic_plots_FINAL.pdf'. 📄✅\n")


df <- readRDS("RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_final_clean_maybe.RDS")

# Load the tidyverse package for data manipulation
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Read your CSV file containing the specimen ages and locations
ages_df <- read_csv("metadata/IBM_specimen_slide.csv")

# 1. Create a new column in `ages_df` to use as the join key.
# We'll call it 'join_key' to avoid confusion with existing 'specimen' columns.
ages_df_formatted <- ages_df %>%
  mutate(join_key = sprintf("oto%02d", otonumber))

# 2. Select the columns to add.
# Here, we select the REAL specimen number column ('specimen') and rename it
# to 'specimen_number' for clarity in the final dataframe.
ages_to_join <- ages_df_formatted %>%
  select(
    join_key,
    specimen_number = specimen, # Selects 'specimen' column and renames it
    area
  )

# 3. Perform the left join
# Match the 'specimen' column from the main df with our new 'join_key'.
full_df <- left_join(df, ages_to_join, by = c("specimen" = "join_key")) %>% 
  select(specimen, transect, specimen_number, area, everything())


# 4. Verify the result
# The new columns 'specimen_number' and 'area' should appear correctly.
cat("Corrected join complete:\n")
head(full_df)

saveRDS(full_df, "RDS_dataframes/ICP-MS_updated.RDS")
```
